persons.name: Dharmadhara
persons.evidence: vajrācāṛya dharmadhralena, tha(va)ta, vyākhyānayā yayā taco yā julo

purpose: svārtha (thavata vyākhyānayā yayā taco yā julo)
notes: NS 819 corresponds to c. 1699 CE. 'parmmadhra' is a characteristic Newari scribal spelling of Padmadhara (or Paramadhara). The corrupt word 'bhābhṛ' directly following 'parmmadhra' and preceding 'vajrācāṛya dharmmadhra' is almost certainly a misreading or scribal corruption of 'bhrātṛ' (brother). Makhan Bāhāl in Kathmandu is the popular name of Ratnakīrti Mahāvihāra. Scribe Vajrācārya Dharmadhara produced/kept the manuscript for his own use ('thavata vyākhyānayā').
